sources.purpose: Accepted top eight idle poses; initial back-hop bottom eight are unused
sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production hand-painted action-game sprite animation atlas. Reference is the approved WEAPONLESS hero. Create a SQUARE transparent RGBA sprite sheet with EXACTLY FOUR columns and FOUR rows, exactly SIXTEEN isolated full-body sprites. One character per cell, same right-facing 3/4 side camera and same head size/body proportions in every cell. Character: lean adult male, silver spiky hair with vivid red streak, black leather long coat with red lining, high collar, red wrapped near left arm, dark pants and armored black boots. Sword is a separate runtime object, so draw only empty natural gripping red-arm fist; NO sword, knife, blade, hilt, handle, weapon or scabbard. No ground shadows or effects.
TOP TWO ROWS are an 8-frame IDLE BREATHING LOOP, not attacks. Both boots planted on the same floor. Keep red empty fist relaxed beside hip. Every frame is a successive nuanced movement:
1 neutral exhaled, slight weight on rear left leg, coat hanging.
2 breath begins, chest expands and shoulders subtly rise, head lifts 2%, red elbow loosens.
3 inhalation rising, chest more open, silver hair and collar lift subtly, coat hem catches small breeze.
4 inhale peak, shoulders lifted, front knee relaxes and pelvis shifts gently right, red fist rises slightly.
5 exhaling begins, chest descends, head nods minutely, coat and hair continue drifting with lag.
6 exhale deepens, shoulders lower, pelvis smoothly returns left, red fist settles.
7 lowest exhale, shoulders relaxed, hair and coat swing past neutral in opposite direction.
8 return almost to pose1 with hair/coat settling, loop closes.
Subtle but unmistakable true 8-frame breathing and weight-shift cycle. Do NOT repeat identical pose. Preserve anatomy without changing scale, weapon-ready posture and forward confident gaze.
BOTTOM TWO ROWS are a sequential 8-frame BACK HOP DODGE, moving to LEFT while character keeps facing RIGHT:
1 ready stance, red fist hip.
2 low preparatory crouch, torso lowers, both knees bend, red fist tucked toward hip.
3 explosive rearward takeoff: front/right boot toe pushes off to right, body leans slightly backward LEFT, coat lags toward RIGHT, red fist tucked low.
4 airborne traveling LEFT, BOTH knees tucked, torso upright and facing right, coat streams toward right, red fist hip.
5 rearward gliding apex, knees begin extending, body stays composed, coat billows right.
6 descending LEFT, rear/left boot reaches down to land, front/right knee remains bent, coat follows.
7 soft low landing compression, boots planted, knees bend and torso dips, red fist tucked.
8 recover ready stance with gentle residual coat sway.
Dynamic accurate physics and strong distinct silhouettes on back hop. All 16 full bodies fit safely in own cells with generous transparent gutters. Crisp dark contours, rich cel-shaded painterly detailing matching reference. Real transparency, absolutely no colored background, no labels, no guides, no grid lines, no text.

sources.purpose: Dedicated backward-hop eight-pose replacement with rearward lean
sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw SQUARE transparent 2D animation atlas with EXACTLY EIGHT full-body hero poses in 4 columns by 2 occupied rows, lower half transparent. Reference is weaponless hero identity: silver hair with red streak, black long coat red lining, red wrapped near arm, black pants and boots. Camera fixed side 3/4 view, head ALWAYS facing RIGHT. Empty red gripping fist, NO weapon/sword/blade/hilt/scabbard, no shadow or effects.
Action is a BACKWARD HOP evading an attack approaching from the RIGHT. He travels LEFT while still looking RIGHT, so this must look different from a forward running leap. Torso tilts slightly BACKWARD toward LEFT, hips travel left, head faces right. Coat inertia floats toward RIGHT rather than stretching to left like a sprint. There is no forward runner crouch in midair.
Eight chronological poses:
1 ready standing, both boots grounded, red fist hip.
2 deep preparatory crouch, chest still upright and head right, red fist moves in front of ribs in defensive guard.
3 backward takeoff: right/front toe pushes floor; hips shift LEFT behind planted foot; shoulders lean BACK LEFT, open chest faces right; red fist at chest.
4 suspended rearward flight: torso diagonally leaning BACK LEFT, both knees tucked in FRONT toward RIGHT, both boots suspended, gaze right; red fist at chest, coat billows gently toward RIGHT.
5 apex rearward flight: shoulders remain behind hips to LEFT, knees move toward RIGHT and soles hang below; head faces right, red fist chest, coat drifts right.
6 descending rearward: LEFT/rear boot reaches down under hips toward floor, right/front knee remains lifted toward right; head faces right, torso still slightly leaning back, fist chest.
7 low landing compression: left boot plants under hips, right boot catches beside it, knees absorb impact, chest upright, red fist lowers hip.
8 recover tall standing facing right, red fist hip, coat settles.
Make a clear BACK LEAN in poses3–5, not forward lean: shoulders positioned to LEFT of pelvis, knees positioned to RIGHT of pelvis. Anatomically natural, full bodies identical scale with crisp detailed painted anime game-sprite quality matching reference. Large transparent gutters around each figure. No text, labels, grid lines, colored background. Real transparent RGBA. Eight distinct meaningful body silhouettes for smooth back-hop.

sources.purpose: Eight upright vertical jump poses, takeoff/rise/apex/fall/landing
sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production hand-painted 2D action-game jumping animation. Produce a SQUARE transparent RGBA atlas with EXACTLY FOUR columns and TWO occupied rows at top; eight isolated full-body characters, lower half empty transparent. Same right-facing fixed 3/4 side camera and identical body/head size across frames. Attached weaponless reference defines character: handsome lean adult fighter, spiky silver hair with red streak, black high-collar leather long coat red inner lining, dark trousers, black armored boots, red wrapped near arm. His sword is added later by engine: empty natural gripping fist only. NO blade, hilt, handle, knife, sword, scabbard, weapons, glow, shadow or effects.
EIGHT successive true JUMP PHASES left to right:
1 neutral upright ready, both feet grounded, near red fist low beside hip.
2 takeoff compression, deep symmetrical knee bend, torso forward slightly, coat gathers around hips, red fist tucked at hip.
3 push-off extension, legs lengthen with toe contact at the floor, chest rises upright, pelvis rises, red fist slightly behind hip, coat trails downward.
4 early ascending airborne, near/front knee lifted toward chest, rear knee bends naturally, torso upright, RED fist behind low hip, coat flutters downward.
5 apex floating, BOTH knees tucked under pelvis, torso remains upright and head gazes right, red fist beside hip, coat hem floats gently UP to the sides; broad distinct upright airborne silhouette.
6 beginning descent, knees partially release, toes point down, near red fist relaxed beside hip, coat remains floating with secondary lag.
7 descending preparation for landing, legs reach down below pelvis, near boot sole points downward to catch floor, torso tilts slightly forward, red fist comes toward hip, coat lifts a little behind.
8 soft landing compression, both boots grounded, knees bend under weight, torso settles low, coat catches up around back, red fist tucked.
This is a VERTICAL JUMP, no running lunge and no sideways sprint. Upright torso through frames3–6. Each silhouette distinct with natural anatomy and smooth succession. Real hand-painted crisp anime cel-shaded detail matching reference, same scale, full head/boots in every cell with wide transparent gutters. No text, labels, guides, grid lines, background or shadows. Exact 8 sprites in 4x2 top layout.
